title: Catalog entry
description: Envelope shared by every catalog entry (spell, creature, item, class, feature, condition, rule...). The catalog is the immutable template; instances (a combatant's HP, conditions, spent resources) live in game state and only point to the entry's ref. Kind-specific fields go in 'data' and are validated by the kind's schema (added by the lot that owns the kind).

kind.description: Entry kind; must equal the kind segment of the ref.

name.description: Name exactly as printed in the source.

tier.description: Automation tier. 0 = reference text only; 1 = structured stats in facets/data (or in system.json); 2 = declarative effects; 3 = master decisions for edge cases (with or without effects).

text.description: Verbatim source text of the entry (markdown conventions of the extraction). Always present for official content: it is the tier-0 fallback and the reference for coverage.

facets.description: Flat, indexable summary used by the manifest (level, school, cr, rarity...).

data.description: Kind-specific structured content (see schema/kinds/*.schema.json when present).

coverage.description: Partition of 'text' into consecutive segments, each saying how it is represented. Joined in order, the segments must reproduce 'text' exactly (whitespace-normalized): this is how the validator proves no rule was dropped.

refs.description: Every ref this entry points to (derived; recomputed by the validator).

inconsistencies.description: Contradictions inside the source that affect this entry, recorded as found (never silently fixed).

decision.description: Master decision id that resolves it at the table.

extends.description: Homebrew: the entry this one derives from. The engine resolves base + overrides; the base is never modified.

overrides.description: Homebrew: JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396) applied to the 'extends' entry.

status.description: structured: represented by effects/data (pointers in 'by'). shared_rule: defers to another entry (refs in 'by'). master_decision: needs the GM (decision ids in 'by'). descriptive: flavor or explanation with no mechanics.

by.description: JSON pointers ('/effects/0'), refs ('dnd5e/condition/poisoned') or 'md:<id>' for master decisions.
